overview: Operational resilience slice built around a Redis-backed distributed rate limiter so that limits hold across future instances, plus a readiness probe, correlation-id middleware and problem-details hardening.

components.name: Infrastructure/RedisRateLimiter
components.responsibility: Sliding-window counter per client IP stored in Redis (StackExchange.Redis), shared by all instances.

components.name: Endpoints/LinkEndpoints.MapHealthEndpoints
components.responsibility: Add /health/ready checking SQLite and Redis connectivity.

components.name: Program.cs
components.responsibility: Register Redis connection multiplexer, limiter, exception handler, middleware.

decisions.decision: Use a Redis-backed sliding-window rate limiter.
decisions.rationale: A shared store makes limits consistent if the service is scaled out later.
decisions.tradeoffs: Introduces a Redis dependency and a new NuGet package (StackExchange.Redis).

testStrategy: Integration tests with a Redis test container.
securityConsiderations: Redis connection string must come from configuration, never source.
